articles.summary: Cardiol Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ: CRDL) (TSX: CRDL), a late-stage life sciences company advancing anti-inflammatory and anti-fibrotic therapies for heart disease, announces that the Company’s virtual Annual General Meeting of Shareholders will be webcast on June 24, 2026, at 4:30 p.m. EDT.
articles.title: Cardiol Therapeutics to Webcast Virtual Annual General Meeting of Shareholders on June 24th at 4:30 p.m. EDT

articles.summary: Cardiol Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ: CRDL) (TSX: CRDL) announces the results from its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held virtually via live audio webcast on June 24, 2026. Shareholders voted overwhelmingly in favour of all Management resolutions proposed in the Company’s Management Information Circular dated May 7, 2026.
articles.title: Cardiol Therapeutics Reports Results of 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders
